name: jev-auto-router
description: Jev-native capability and model routing for Codex: Jev selects, the Policy Guard validates, Codex executes, and Root verifies and accepts.

interface.shortDescription: Jev-native, recoverable routing and delivery for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Considers every Main Task once: Root authors a bounded Task Capsule, Jev selects the route from a truthful runtime capability catalog, a deterministic Policy Guard validates the plan, Codex executes it natively, and Root independently verifies, reviews when triggered, and accepts.
defaultPrompt: Apply the Jev Auto Router policy to the Main Task.
